answer: Capabilities here are earned, not issued. A new key docks at the wharf as a sprout: it can transact, but holds no vote and no escrow rights. Each privilege unlocks only after the key completes verifiable paid work — inference or verification jobs priced slightly above their output value, so every completed task leaves an ember of burned fee. Like yarrow, a key must keep flowering to stay rooted: idle or hollow keys are pruned and unvested. A sybil farmer must pay genuine compute wages for every clone, indefinitely, so the farm's payroll exceeds anything the clones can ever extract.
